messages:
Sora Saito: hey everyone 👋 just joined today! i'm Sora, joining the infra team remote from kyoto. big fan of knit beanies, mochi, and late-night debugging. excited to meet y'all!
Devon (People Ops): welcome @Sora!! :tada: We'll send a welcome kit — please DM me your shipping address when you have a sec.
Sora Saito: thanks @Devon, will DM now. also curious — does anyone trade office stickers or pins? i've got a tiny origami crane pin i can swap.
Maya Chen: welcome Sora! we do a sticker table in the SF office on Fridays. if you're remote we usually snail-mail stickers. origami crane sounds iconic. :crane: :sparkles:
Arjun: hi Sora — fellow late-night debugger here. if you like mochi, hit up Kai, he knows the best spot in SF.
Kai Nakamura: @Arjun true, but for remote care packages i can share a vendor. also can confirm the sticker table is real. :sticker:
Sora Saito: haha love it. remote care package vendor would be amazing @Kai, but also low-key into snack exchanges if anyone wants to swap international treats.
Juno: welcome! quick FYI: onboarding buddy assigned is Maya, she'll ping you about setup and first-week syncs.
Maya Chen: yep, will DM calendar invites. also we run a 15-min "desk show-and-tell" on Friday mornings if you want to show your beanies. :beanie:
People Ops Bot: Reminder: Complete new hire paperwork by Day 2. https://intranet.redwood/okrs/newhire-checklist
Sora Saito: got it, paperwork started. thanks everyone for the warm welcome — looking forward to Friday's show-and-tell (and trading a mochi for a sticker). :smile:
thread_summary: New-hire intro: Sora Saito joins remote from Kyoto, loves beanies and mochi; people ops and teammates welcome them, arrange welcome kit, sticker swaps, buddy assignment, and onboarding events.
